apps.name: ArchiveTeam Warrior
apps.description: Lend your spare internet time to help save websites before they disappear
apps.compose:
services:
  archive-team-warrior-init:
    image: atdr.meo.ws/archiveteam/warrior-dockerfile:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_PREFIX}archive-team-warrior-init
    user: "0:0"
    network_mode: none
    read_only: true
    entrypoint: ["/bin/sh", "-ec"]
    command:
      - |
        if [ -L /owned/data/wget-at ] && [ "$(readlink /owned/data/wget-at)" = /usr/local/bin/wget-lua ]; then
          rm -- /owned/data/wget-at
        fi
        cp -aLn /home/warrior/data/. /owned/data/
        chown -Rh 1000:1000 /owned/projects /owned/data
    volumes:
      - ${CONFIG_PATH}/archive-team-warrior/projects:/owned/projects
      - ${CONFIG_PATH}/archive-team-warrior/data:/owned/data

  archive-team-warrior:
    image: atdr.meo.ws/archiveteam/warrior-dockerfile:latest
    container_name: ${CONTAINER_PREFIX}archive-team-warrior
    restart: ${RESTART_POLICY}
    user: "1000:1000"
    depends_on:
      archive-team-warrior-init:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
    environment:
      TZ: ${TZ}
      DOWNLOADER: ${ARCHIVE_TEAM_WARRIOR_NICKNAME}
      SELECTED_PROJECT: "none"
      CONCURRENT_ITEMS: "1"
      HTTP_USERNAME: ${ADMIN_USER}
      HTTP_PASSWORD: ${ADMIN_PASSWORD}
    volumes:
      - ${CONFIG_PATH}/archive-team-warrior/projects:/home/warrior/projects
      - ${CONFIG_PATH}/archive-team-warrior/data:/home/warrior/data
    ports:
      - 8001:8001
